items.reason: Temozolomide is given at standard Stupp doses ("75 mg/m2 daily for 6 weeks"; adjuvant 150-200 mg/m2) as background, so it is soc_backbone, not an established_therapy_experiment; the question is radiotherapy ("intensified radiation therapy adapted during the radiation treatment course"). established_therapy_only does not fit.

note: Convention question for XL: when the only tested intervention is radiotherapy or a device and the only drug is a backbone/supportive agent, S6 reason could be no_pharmacological_candidate or excluded_intervention_type (radiotherapy alone and devices are listed as excluded types in manual 1.2). Proposed no_pharmacological_candidate throughout this batch (NCT04574856, NCT06140875, NCT05284643, NCT06929819) for consistency. cns5_terminology historical agreed ("WHO grade IV gliomas including glioblastoma", no IDH requirement).
